definitions.music_descriptor: An expressed non-genre musical property, context or selection criterion, such as mood, tempo, era, rating, listening history or use context. A genre/style identity alone, or a bare work, creator, service or playback-operation identity, does not supply this additional role. Apply request-relevant scope.
definitions.place_name: An identifying geographic location, event venue or travel/delivery destination reference. A domestic room or surface used only to locate or scope household device control or cleaning does not supply this role. A domestic place independently serving as an event venue or destination may qualify. Apply request-relevant scope.

music_descriptor: Genre/style identity and a descriptive property are separate task roles. A genre used to select songs does not automatically satisfy the non-genre descriptor predicate.

Quality/rating, mood, tempo, era, history-relative selection, topic or use context can support music_descriptor when explicitly attached to music. A named artist, work, platform or playback mode alone cannot.

A phrase may express both roles: soft jazz supplies a softness descriptor and jazz genre; best country songs of the nineties supplies quality/era plus genre. A genre word need not be copied into the descriptor label.

Classify by the expressed semantic role rather than a native label or rigid dictionary. Terms that may be genre names or descriptive properties without enough context remain unavailable. Do not resolve rating attachment or bare classic using label metadata.
place_name: Domestic room/area identity used solely to select household devices, control an ambient setting or delimit cleaning is house_place evidence, not an additional place_name role.

A domestic location can independently be a destination or venue for a represented event; such a role may support place_name as well as house_place. No global exclusion or house_place-implies-place_name rule applies.

Geographic references and non-domestic event venues qualify without a proper name when the location reference is identifying. Do not infer an address or geographic location from a company, device or room name alone.
Whether listening/broadcast location supplies an event venue versus merely a household device selector must be supported by the utterance. Insufficient context remains unavailable.

reading: Complete references in three diagnostic cohorts read, including every native music_genre/music_descriptor/house_place learning source. Cohorts are evidence retrieval, not rules that assign labels.

upstream_evidence.interpretation: Upstream distinguishes house control areas and musical genre/property roles, but does not prove semantic exclusivity. Explicit project definitions below are design choices, not recovered official gold.

deferred_scope.reason: Upstream conversation and preference acts exist, but admitting every standalone report would change all55 request-scope predicates. Complete dialogue-act and implicit-request policy is needed before a global revision; do not infer intent from native labels.
